$comment: Shared schema-detection vectors (#7691). Each `content` (with `{PAD}` replaced by `pad` copies of 'x') must classify to `expected` in BOTH the Rust detector (rust/processing/src/processor/schema_detection.rs) and the TS parser's detectSchemaVersion (packages/parser/src/source-header.ts).

lower-case ifc4 (#4661)
IFC4X3 with an addendum suffix, lower-case
